plantillas.name: Morning Routine
plantillas.lectura: Every morning, I get up at seven. I wash my face and I brush my teeth. Then I get dressed and I eat breakfast. I eat bread and I drink milk. After breakfast, I take my bag and I go to school. I like my morning routine. It helps me start the day with energy.

preguntes.q: What does the person do in the morning?
opcions: He gets up and goes to school

plantillas.name: My Family
plantillas.lectura: I love my family. My mother is kind. My father is funny. I have a brother. We live together in a small house. In the evening, we eat dinner together. We talk and we laugh. My family is very important to me. They help me every day.

plantillas.name: My School
plantillas.lectura: My school is big and beautiful. I go to school every day. My teacher is nice. She teaches us English. In class, I read books and I write. In the playground, I play with my friends. I like my school. I learn new things every day.

preguntes.q: What do you do at school?

plantillas.name: My House
plantillas.lectura: My house is small but nice. It has a kitchen, a living room and two bedrooms. In my bedroom, I have a bed, a table and a window. I like my window. I can see the park. At home, I rest, I read and I play. My house is my favourite place.

plantillas.name: My Friends
plantillas.lectura: I have good friends. We play together in the park. We play football and we run. When I am sad, my friends help me. When they are sad, I help them. We share our toys. We laugh a lot. A good friend listens and helps. I am happy with my friends.

preguntes.q: What does a good friend do?

plantillas.name: My Food
plantillas.lectura: I like healthy food. In the morning, I eat fruit and bread. At lunch, I eat rice and salad. I drink water every day. I do not drink a lot of sugar drinks. Healthy food gives me energy. I feel strong and happy when I eat well.

plantillas.name: My City
plantillas.lectura: My city is beautiful. It has a big park, a library and a market. In the park, I walk and I play. In the library, I read books. In the market, I buy fruit. I walk in the centre with my family. I love my city. It is my home.

plantillas.name: My Day
plantillas.lectura: My day starts in the morning. I go to school. I learn and I play. After school, I go home. I do my homework. Then I play in the park. In the evening, I eat dinner with my family. At night, I read a book and I sleep. It is a good day.

preguntes.q: What do you do after school?
opcions: Go to sleep in the park

plantillas.name: My Hobby
plantillas.lectura: My hobby is drawing. I draw every day. I draw animals, houses and my family. I have colours and paper. Drawing makes me happy. When I draw, I feel calm. I want to learn more. My hobby is my favourite time of the day.

plantillas.name: My Pet
plantillas.lectura: I have a dog. His name is Max. Max is small and brown. Every day, I play with Max in the park. I give him water and food. Max runs and jumps. I love Max. A pet is a friend. We must take care of our pet every day.

preguntes.q: What do you do with your pet?
opcions: Play and take care of him

plantillas.name: My Teacher
plantillas.lectura: My teacher is kind. Her name is Anna. She teaches us in class. She reads stories and she helps us. When I do not understand, she explains again. She is patient. I like my teacher. I learn a lot with her.

plantillas.name: My Clothes
plantillas.lectura: Today I wear a blue T-shirt and black trousers. I wear white shoes. In winter, I wear a warm jacket. In summer, I wear a hat. I choose my clothes in the morning. I like clean and comfortable clothes. I dress by myself.

plantillas.name: My Body
plantillas.lectura: My body is important. I have two hands, two feet, two eyes and one mouth. I wash my hands every day. I run in the park. I eat healthy food. I sleep well. When I take care of my body, I feel strong and happy.

preguntes.q: How do you take care of your body?

plantillas.name: My Week
plantillas.lectura: My week has seven days. From Monday to Friday, I go to school. On Saturday, I play with my friends. On Sunday, I rest with my family. Every day is different. I like Saturday best. It is my day to play and to rest.

preguntes.q: When do you go to school?

plantillas.name: My Toys
plantillas.lectura: I have many toys. I have a ball, a car and a puzzle. I play with my brother. We share our toys. After we play, we put the toys in the box. It is good to share. It is good to tidy up. Playing with toys is fun.

preguntes.q: What do you do after playing?

plantillas.name: Daily Habits
plantillas.lectura: Your habits make your day. If you wake up early, you have more time. If you make a small list, you know what to do. Good habits are small actions you repeat every day. You do not need a perfect day. You need a simple routine. Drink water, read ten minutes, and go to bed early. Small habits, repeated, change your life.

opcions: A small action you repeat every day
A big action once a year

plantillas.name: Healthy Life
plantillas.lectura: A healthy life is not a diet. It is a way to live. You should move your body every day. You should eat more vegetables and drink more water. You should sleep seven or eight hours. You do not need to be perfect. You need to be consistent. When your body feels good, your mind feels good too.

preguntes.q: What should you do for a healthy life?

plantillas.name: Learning English
plantillas.lectura: Learning English is a journey. You do not learn it in one day. You learn a little every day. Listen to a song. Read a short text. Speak one sentence. Do not be afraid to make mistakes. Mistakes are part of learning. When you speak, you learn. When you listen, you learn. Keep going, even if it is slow.

plantillas.name: Travelling
plantillas.lectura: Travelling teaches you a lot. When you visit a new city, you see new streets, new food and new people. You learn new words. You learn to ask for help. You learn to be patient. A trip does not need to be expensive. You can walk, look, taste and listen. Every trip leaves a memory in your heart.

preguntes.q: What do you learn when you travel?
opcions: New words, new people and patience

plantillas.name: Music
plantillas.lectura: Music can change your mood. When you are sad, a calm song can help you. When you are happy, a fast song makes you dance. Music is a language. You do not need to understand all the words to feel it. You can sing, play or just listen. Music connects people from different countries. One song can make a thousand people feel the same.

opcions: Change your mood and connect people

plantillas.name: Positive Mindset
plantillas.lectura: A positive mindset does not mean everything is perfect. It means you choose how to look at things. When something goes wrong, you can say: This is difficult, but I can learn. You can write three good things every night. You can thank people. You can celebrate small wins. Positive thinking is a habit, not magic. You train it every day.

opcions: Choosing how you look at things

plantillas.name: Growth Mindset
plantillas.lectura: People with a growth mindset believe they can improve. They do not say: I am bad at this. They say: I am not good at this yet. An error is not the end. It is information. If you fail, you try a different way. If you do not understand, you ask for help. Growth is slow. But every try makes you a little stronger.

opcions: I am born good or bad

plantillas.name: Confidence
plantillas.lectura: Confidence is not being perfect. Confidence is trusting yourself. You build it with small wins. Prepare your presentation. Practise it aloud. Speak slowly. If you make a mistake, continue. People do not remember your mistake. They remember your courage. The more you try, the more confident you become.

plantillas.name: Fear
plantillas.lectura: Fear is normal. Everybody feels fear. Fear of speaking, fear of failing, fear of the exam. Fear does not mean stop. It means breathe and take one small step. Talk about your fear. Ask for support. Do the scary thing in small parts. When you face your fear, it becomes smaller. You are braver than you think.

preguntes.q: What should you do with fear?
opcions: Breathe and take one small step

plantillas.name: Success
plantillas.lectura: Success is not only money or fame. Success is progress. If you set a goal and you work every day, you are successful. You need a clear goal, a simple plan and patience. Some days you will fail. That is part of success. Celebrate your progress. Success is not a finish line. It is the way you walk every day.

plantillas.name: Progress
plantillas.lectura: Do not compare yourself with others. Compare yourself with yesterday. Yesterday, you did not know this word. Today, you know it. That is progress. Write your progress. One page, one word, one minute. Small progress is still progress. If you stop looking at others and start looking at your path, you will feel proud.

plantillas.name: Taking Action
plantillas.lectura: Many people wait. They wait for motivation. They wait for the perfect moment. But the perfect moment never comes. Action creates motivation, not the other way. Start with two minutes. Open the book. Write one sentence. Do the first step today. A small step is better than a perfect plan that never starts.

plantillas.name: Discipline
plantillas.lectura: Discipline is doing what you said you would do, even when you do not feel like it. Motivation comes and goes. Discipline stays. Make a schedule. Follow it. If you fail one day, come back the next day. Do not quit. Discipline is not punishment. It is freedom. It gives you the life you want.

plantillas.name: Motivation
plantillas.lectura: Motivation is a spark. It helps you start. But it does not last forever. You need a reason. Why do you learn English? Why do you study? Write your reason. Look at it every morning. When motivation goes down, your reason keeps you going. Motivation starts you. Your why keeps you.

preguntes.q: What keeps you going when motivation ends?

plantillas.name: Focus
plantillas.lectura: Focus means doing one thing at a time. When you study, put your phone away. Close other tabs. Work for 25 minutes. Then rest for 5 minutes. Your brain cannot do ten things well. It can do one thing well. If you focus, you finish faster and you remember more.

opcions: Doing one thing at a time

plantillas.name: Procrastination
plantillas.lectura: Procrastination is saying: I will do it later. Later becomes tomorrow. Tomorrow becomes never. You do not procrastinate because you are lazy. You procrastinate because the task feels big. Make it small. Do it for two minutes. Start now. Once you start, it is easier to continue. Do not wait to feel ready. Start, and you will feel ready.

plantillas.name: Friendship
plantillas.lectura: A real friend listens. A real friend does not judge. When you have a bad day, a friend says: I am here. Friendship is not about being together all the time. It is about being there when it matters. Be honest. Say sorry when you are wrong. Celebrate when your friend wins. Good friendship makes life lighter.

preguntes.q: What does a real friend do?

plantillas.name: Kindness
plantillas.lectura: Kindness is small and powerful. A smile. A thank you. Opening a door. Helping a classmate. You do not need money to be kind. You need attention. When you are kind to others, you feel good too. One kind act can change someone's whole day. Be kind every day, even in small things.

opcions: Small acts like a smile and help

plantillas.name: Gratitude
plantillas.lectura: Gratitude means seeing what you already have. You have food. You have a home. You have people who care about you. Every night, write three good things. They can be small. A coffee. A message. A sunny day. When you practise gratitude, you feel calmer and happier. You stop wanting more, and you start enjoying what you have.

plantillas.name: Creativity
plantillas.lectura: Creativity is not only for artists. Creativity is finding a new way. You can be creative in cooking, in studying, in solving problems. Allow yourself crazy ideas. Draw. Write. Try. Do not be afraid to fail. A bad idea can lead to a good idea. Play with ideas. Creativity grows when you use it.

plantillas.name: Technology
plantillas.lectura: Technology can help you learn. You can watch videos, use apps, and talk to people in other countries. But technology can also distract you. If you check your phone every minute, you cannot focus. Use technology with balance. Check before you share. Ask: Is this true? Use your phone as a tool, not as a boss.

plantillas.name: Environment
plantillas.lectura: The planet is our home. We must take care of it. Recycle your plastic. Bring your own bag. Use a bike when you can. Do not waste water. Small actions matter. If we all do a little, we change a lot. The Earth does not need perfect people. It needs many people doing small things every day.

preguntes.q: What can you do for the planet?

plantillas.name: Sport
plantillas.lectura: Sport is good for your body and your mind. When you train, you learn discipline. You learn to work in a team. You learn to respect rules. You do not always win. Sometimes you lose. That is okay. Sport teaches you to try again. Play for fun. Move your body. Feel alive.

preguntes.q: What do you learn with sport?

plantillas.name: Reading
plantillas.lectura: Reading is a superpower. When you read, you travel without moving. You meet new people. You learn new words. Read ten pages every day. It does not need to be a big book. It can be a short story. If you do not like a book, try another one. Reading every day will change the way you think.

plantillas.name: Cooking
plantillas.lectura: Cooking is a life skill. When you cook, you choose what you eat. You can cook with fresh ingredients. You can follow a recipe. Cut vegetables. Taste the food. Share it with your family. Cooking with calm is a form of care. A home-cooked meal tastes like love.

opcions: Choosing what you eat and sharing it

plantillas.name: Leadership
plantillas.lectura: A good leader does not give orders. A good leader gives example. Leadership is listening before deciding. It is taking responsibility when things go wrong, and sharing credit when things go well. A leader does not need to be the loudest person in the room. A leader needs to be the clearest. If you want to lead, start by leading yourself: be on time, be honest, be consistent.

preguntes.q: What does a good leader do?
opcions: Listen, give example and take responsibility

plantillas.name: Critical Thinking
plantillas.lectura: Do not believe everything you read. Critical thinking means asking: Who says this? What is the evidence? Is there another view? Many news stories are made to make you angry or afraid. Before you share, check the source. Compare two sources. Look for data, not just opinions. Thinking critically is not being negative. It is being free. You decide with your mind, not with your fear.

opcions: Ask for evidence and compare sources

plantillas.name: Empathy
plantillas.lectura: Empathy is putting yourself in someone else's shoes. It is not saying: I understand, when you do not listen. It is listening without judging. When a friend is sad, do not fix it fast. Ask: How do you feel? Stay. Be there. Empathy does not mean you agree with everything. It means you respect what the other person feels. The world needs more listening and less judging.

plantillas.name: Resilience
plantillas.lectura: Life will hit you. You will fail an exam. You will lose a job. You will feel broken. Resilience is not never falling. Resilience is getting up after you fall. Accept what happened. Ask for help. Rest if you need. Then try again, with a new plan. People who are resilient are not stronger. They are more patient. They know that pain is not the end of the story.

plantillas.name: Teamwork
plantillas.lectura: No one wins alone. Teamwork is not dividing work. It is sharing a goal. A good team communicates clearly. It says what it needs. It respects differences. If one person fails, the team helps. If one person wins, the team celebrates. The best teams are not made of perfect people. They are made of people who trust each other and do their part.

plantillas.name: Decision Making
plantillas.lectura: Every day you decide. What to study. What to eat. What to say. Some decisions are small. Some change your life. To decide well, write the pros and cons. Think about the consequences. Ask for advice, but decide yourself. There is no perfect decision. There is a decision, and then you make it work. Do not wait forever. Decide, act, and learn from the result.

opcions: List pros and cons and decide

plantillas.name: Communication
plantillas.lectura: Communication is not only speaking. It is listening. Many problems come from not listening. When you talk, be clear. Say what you need, not what you think the other person wants to hear. When you listen, do not prepare your answer. Listen to understand. Good communication is honest and kind at the same time. It builds trust. It fixes conflicts. It makes relationships stronger.

opcions: Listen to understand and be clear

plantillas.name: Honesty
plantillas.lectura: Honesty is expensive. It costs you comfort. It costs you likes. But it gives you freedom. When you lie, you must remember the lie. When you are honest, you can rest. Honesty does not mean saying everything you think. It means not pretending. Be honest with others, and be honest with yourself. People may not like your truth, but they will trust you.

plantillas.name: Commitment
plantillas.lectura: Most people don't lack goals. They lack commitment. They start with excitement. Big plans, big promises, a strong push in the beginning that feels powerful and real. But when things get difficult, energy drops. Effort reduces, and consistency breaks. Commitment begins after excitement ends. It is staying consistent when motivation is gone and results are not visible yet. This is where most people stop. Not because they can't do it, but because they don't stay long enough to see the outcome. Committed people think differently. They don't depend on mood. They depend on discipline and responsibility. They continue when it feels boring. They show up when it feels hard. Most people start. Few stay committed long enough to win.

plantillas.name: Patience
plantillas.lectura: Patience is not waiting. Patience is working while you wait. You plant a seed. You water it. You do not see the tree the next day. But you keep watering. Learning, business, relationships, all need time. People who want everything fast, quit fast. People who are patient, build something real. Do not compare your chapter one with someone else's chapter ten. Be patient with yourself. You are growing, even if you cannot see it yet.
